name: e-se-nico
description: Canal de vídeos curtos "E se…" com o Nico (Remotion)

scripts.render: remotion render Ep01 out/ep01.mp4 --codec=h264 && bash scripts/masterizar.sh out/ep01.mp4
scripts.palavras: python3 scripts/alinhar-palavras.py src/episodes/ep01.json src/audio/ep01-transcricao.json src/audio/ep01-words.json apresentacao=200
scripts.render:70s: remotion render Ep01 out/ep01-70s.mp4 --codec=h264 --props='{"extendTo70s":true}' && bash scripts/masterizar.sh out/ep01-70s.mp4
